name: Kamiuta
source:
This is a love simulation game where you help girls with their problems. 

The protagonist is able solve problems by removing the spiritual stagnation that causes them. Will he use the techniques that have been passed down in his family to help the girls?  Or will he interact with them and ease their worries? In this game, the girls' futures change depending on your choices.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1381]Getchu.com[/url]]
